requirement.text: The rate-control loop shall be monitored by an independent hardware watchdog. The motor driver shall be latched into a safe (no-pulse) state if a heartbeat from the rate-control task is missed for more than 200 ms.

system_requirements.text: The infusion system shall include independent hardware and software watchdog mechanisms to detect and respond to software failures within 200 ms.

user_needs.text: The infusion system shall prevent over-infusion that could harm the patient.

system_requirements.text: The infusion system shall latch the motor driver into a safe (no-pulse) state when a software failure is detected by the watchdog mechanism.

user_needs.text: The infusion system shall prevent over-infusion that could harm the patient.

system_requirements.text: The infusion system shall provide visual and audible alarms to clinicians when a safety-critical failure is detected, including failures of the rate-control loop.

user_needs.text: The infusion system shall provide clear and immediate feedback to clinicians when a safety-critical failure is detected.

test_cases.description: Functional verification of watchdog heartbeat reception under nominal load
test_cases.setup: Pump in standard infusion mode; rate-control task running at 50 ms cadence; hardware watchdog enabled with 200 ms latch threshold.
test_cases.steps: 1. Start a 30-minute infusion at 5 mL/hr. 2. Monitor watchdog heartbeat counter. 3. Verify motor driver remains armed and pump delivers commanded rate.
test_cases.expectedResults: 1. Heartbeat counter increments at the expected cadence. 2. Motor driver remains armed throughout. 3. Delivered volume matches commanded volume within tolerance.

test_cases.description: Fault injection — simulate scheduler stall and verify watchdog latches the motor driver
test_cases.setup: Pump in standard infusion mode; instrumented build with a debug hook to suspend the rate-control task indefinitely.
test_cases.steps: 1. Start an infusion at 5 mL/hr. 2. Trigger the debug hook to suspend the rate-control task. 3. Observe the watchdog timer and motor driver state. 4. Observe the UI banner.
test_cases.expectedResults: 1. Watchdog counter stalls as expected. 2. After 200 ms, the motor driver latches to the safe state and stops issuing pulses. 3. The UI renders the Alarm Mode banner and silences the nominal-rate display.

test_cases.description: Boundary — heartbeat latency exactly at 200 ms threshold
test_cases.setup: Pump in standard infusion mode; instrumented build with a debug hook to delay the rate-control task heartbeat by a configurable amount.
test_cases.steps: 1. Start an infusion. 2. Configure the debug hook to delay heartbeats by 199 ms; verify motor driver remains armed. 3. Configure to 200 ms; verify armed at boundary. 4. Configure to 201 ms; verify motor driver latches to safe state.
test_cases.expectedResults: 1. At 199 ms delay motor driver is armed. 2. At 200 ms delay motor driver is armed (inclusive boundary). 3. At 201 ms delay motor driver latches to safe state and UI Alarm Mode banner renders.

design_docs.name: Rate Control Loop and Watchdog Architecture
design_docs.description: Describes the segregation of the rate-control task from the UI task, the heartbeat protocol, the hardware watchdog wiring, and the safe-state latch behavior of the motor driver. Documents the 200 ms timeout threshold and the fail-safe state machine that transitions the motor driver to no-pulse mode when heartbeats are missed.

design_docs.name: Hardware Watchdog Interface Design
design_docs.description: Specifies the hardware watchdog timer interface, including the GPIO pin assignments for heartbeat signals, the watchdog timer configuration (200 ms timeout), and the motor driver latch control signals. Documents the electrical characteristics of the safe-state latch circuit.

design_docs.name: UI Alarm Mode Detailed Design
design_docs.description: Detailed design of the UI alarm rendering logic, including the state machine that monitors the rate-control task heartbeat, the Alarm Mode banner component, and the logic that silences nominal-rate displays when the alarm is active. Documents the UI thread's dependency on the same heartbeat signal monitored by the hardware watchdog.

design_docs.name: Software FMEA - Rate Control Loop
design_docs.description: Failure modes and effects analysis for the rate control software component, including scheduler stall scenarios, watchdog timeout analysis, and motor driver fail-safe behavior. Documents the severity, occurrence, and detection ratings for each failure mode, and the risk priority numbers (RPNs) that drove the design of the hardware watchdog and UI alarm controls.

design_docs.name: Software Risk Analysis - Infusion Pump v3.2
design_docs.description: Comprehensive software risk analysis document that traces hazards from the hazard register to software requirements, design elements, and verification test cases. Documents the risk control measures implemented in software, the residual risk analysis, and the risk acceptability decisions per ISO 14971.

requirement.text: The system shall continuously monitor the ultrasonic air-in-line sensor and latch the motor driver into a safe state if an air volume exceeding 50 microliters is detected.

system_requirements.text: The infusion system shall detect and prevent the infusion of clinically significant air into the patient.

user_needs.text: The infusion system shall protect the patient from air embolisms.

requirement.text: The system shall trigger a hard interrupt from the ultrasonic sensor to halt the motor immediately if an air bubble exceeding 50 microliters is detected.

system_requirements.text: The system shall detect and prevent clinically significant air from reaching the patient.

user_needs.text: The system shall protect the patient from air embolism.

test_cases.steps: 1. Inject 50uL air bubble into upstream line. 2. Verify immediate motor halt and alarm.
test_cases.expectedResults: 1. Motor halts within 100ms. 2. Air-in-line alarm active.

requirement.text: The software shall utilize dual-channel ADC reading for the downstream pressure sensor and halt therapy if readings diverge by >5% or exceed 15 PSI.

system_requirements.text: The system shall monitor downstream pressure and halt upon occlusion.

user_needs.text: The system shall prevent tissue damage from over-pressure.

requirement.text: A hardwired low-voltage threshold shall trigger a high-priority alarm independent of the software battery capacity algorithm.
